feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. The Integrator kept the iteration 5 controller unchanged, so this result reflects the Builder's wheel_track change alone. Evidence: iteration 5 (wheel_radius 0.035 m, mass 0.6 kg, track 0.12 m) is the best state so far at 51.01, with s-bend progress 0.155, slalom 0.107 and max_error 0.061 to 0.066. Iteration 6 (mass 0.5 kg) lowered s-bend progress to 0.149 and raised max_error to 0.068, so lower mass is not the lever at this speed. Iteration 3 narrowed the track to 0.10 m and lowered s-bend progress from 0.15 to 0.13, which suggests too much turn rate per PWM. Widening the track to 0.14 m reduces turn rate, so the test is the opposite of iteration 3. Gain changes in iterations 0, 1, 4 and 5 left max_error almost unchanged, so the controller is not the main limit and I did not compensate for the lower turn rate. Interpret the next race as follows. If progress holds at or above 0.155 on the s-bend and 0.107 on the slalom, and max_error stays at or below 0.069, the wider track helps. Try wheel_track 0.16 m next. If progress falls below those values, turn rate is not the limit. Return wheel_track to 0.12 m and test wheel_radius 0.04 m with mass 0.6 kg, which is the speed step that raised progress in iteration 5. If progress holds but max_error rises above 0.069, the robot has lost turning authority at bends. Keep the track at 0.14 m and let the Integrator raise kp; do not change the geometry again yet.
requested_changes: If progress holds at or above 0.155 on the s-bend and 0.107 on the slalom with max_error at or below 0.069, try wheel_track 0.16 m with wheel_radius 0.035 m and mass 0.6 kg. Iteration 3 showed narrowing the track lowered s-bend progress, so widening it is the next step in the same direction.

If progress falls below 0.155 on the s-bend or 0.107 on the slalom, return wheel_track to 0.12 m and set wheel_radius to 0.04 m with mass 0.6 kg. Iteration 5 showed wheel_radius 0.03 to 0.035 m raised s-bend progress from 0.149 to 0.155 with max_error held, so speed is the next lever.
Keep mass at 0.6 kg in every next step. Iteration 6 showed mass 0.5 kg lowered progress (s-bend 0.155 to 0.149) and raised max_error (0.065 to 0.068), so do not reduce mass again.
